answer.summary: The goal is not mathematically impossible, but the current real-data 2026-01-01..2026-06-10 evidence does not justify production promotion. The strongest candidates improve holdout results, but either miss the production gate narrowly or collapse when all guarded observations are included.

data_basis.backfill_state: period-sidecar prepared caches were already backfilled for the research path; no dummy-filled promotion evidence was used

scanner_reasons: KOSPI candidates came from prefilter-ranked three-stage selections.
KOSDAQ candidates came from day_return-ranked three-stage selections.
Candidate rows used KIS period-sidecar features and realized touch5_dd10 labels only for evaluation.
aggregation_notes: Selected cases were grouped by market, pool, pool_k, final_topn, score_mode, and max_tail_prob.
Guards were learned on chronological selected-train rows and evaluated on selected-holdout rows.
Compound guard search used AND keep rules from train-side improving single-feature guard seeds.
backtest_diagnostics: The production gate requires enough n, active days, active runs, hit5_dd10_5d_pct, min_low_5d_pct, and expected touch-policy economics.
Small holdout winners were not promoted when all guarded observations showed unstable min-low or weak hit rate.
market_news_context: No separate news-regime override was applied in this decision; sidecar news/date coverage was used as input features only.
agent_trace.planner_decision: Do not promote to production from this data window. Keep KOSPI as the only meaningful forward-shadow lane; keep KOSDAQ observation-only.

kospi.interpretation: This is the closest path found. It creates positive holdout economics, but it is not stable enough across all guarded observations.

kosdaq.interpretation: The holdout winner is too small to trust. When all guarded observations are included, the tail risk remains above production limits.

decision: Do not promote any candidate to production from the current real-data window.
Keep KOSPI compound-guarded three-stage selection as the primary forward-shadow lane.
Do not chase more parameter-only searches on this same window unless they add genuinely new data or a stricter out-of-sample design.
Next useful research should accumulate additional forward-shadow observations and test exit/risk overlays on the KOSPI near-miss path.
